Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title names the main change: a missing space in the Host details Apple MDM enrollment banner is added. It is specific, concise, and matches the changeset (HostDetailsBanners.tsx text fix, a new test, and a changes file).
Full details: Description check

**Explanation** The description follows the template's main structure. It links the issue (Resolves `#59026`), explains the root cause and the fix, and completes the changes-file and automated-test items. It also includes the required AI section. Gaps: the frontend screenshot item is unchecked and manual QA is not reported as done. The description also omits the template's Frontend before/after screenshot, which is required for user-visible UI changes. **Resolution** Attach a before and after screenshot under the Frontend section, as the template asks for user-visible UI changes. Also confirm manual QA or mark that item as not done.
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** Issue `#59026` asks for a space between "the" and the bold setting name in the yellow "This host can't enroll in Apple MDM" banner. At the reviewed head, HostDetailsBanners.tsx renders "turn off the{" "}" followed by <strong>Allow only Apple Business enrollments</strong>, so the space is emitted. The same pattern is used in the "no longer eligible" banner, matching the expected behavior. The test file adds a case that renders the banner for a darwin host with MDM status Off and onlyAllowAppleBusinessEnrollment set, and asserts that container.textContent contains "turn off the Allow only Apple Business enrollments setting". The requirement is coding-only and is met. Manual QA is not a requirement for this assessment. I did not execute the test suite; the pass result rests on the source diff and the test assertion.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check

**Explanation** The whole-PR diff against the merge base changes three files: a changes/ entry for the fix, HostDetailsBanners.tsx (the single added {" "} for the banner line), and HostDetailsBanners.tests.tsx (one new test case for the same banner). Each change supports issue `#59026`. No unrelated code, refactoring, or behavior change was found in the inspected diffs. The changes file follows the repository checklist for user-visible changes.
